# Aparte

> Aparte (also written AparteNG) is a Nigerian platform for booking verified
> short-stay apartments, homes and hotels. Every listing is verified before it
> goes live, caution fees are refundable, and payment is held by Aparte until
> the guest checks in. Travellers browse listings, see real-time availability
> and pricing in NGN, and book instantly or by request. Property owners and
> agents list and manage their spaces. The platform is operated by Aparte
> Digital Limited (RC 9311297), a company registered in Nigeria.

Full machine-readable content (all FAQs, help guides and city coverage):
https://aparte.ng/llms-full.txt

## Company
- Registered name: Aparte Digital Limited
- Registration number: RC 9311297 (Corporate Affairs Commission, Nigeria)
- Country of registration: Nigeria
- Trading names: Aparte, AparteNG
- Website: https://aparte.ng
- Contact: support@aparte.ng

## Key pages
- [Home](https://aparte.ng/): Search and browse verified apartments and homes across Nigeria.
- [Shortlets by city](https://aparte.ng/shortlets): City guides with verified listings for Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, Ibadan, Enugu, Asaba, Ogun and their main districts.
- [Search results](https://aparte.ng/search-results): Filter stays by location, dates, guests, price and property type.
- [About Aparte](https://aparte.ng/about): What Aparte is, how it works and why travellers and hosts use it.
- [Help Center](https://aparte.ng/help): Guides for guests, property owners and agents.
- [FAQ](https://aparte.ng/help/faq): Common questions about booking, payments, cancellations and hosting.
- [Verify a booking](https://aparte.ng/verify): Confirm that a booking or receipt is genuine.

## City pages
- [Shortlets in Lagos](https://aparte.ng/shortlets/lagos): Nigeria's largest shortlet market: Lekki, Victoria Island, Ikoyi, Ikeja.
- [Shortlets in Lekki](https://aparte.ng/shortlets/lekki): The busiest short-stay corridor in Lagos.
- [Shortlets in Victoria Island](https://aparte.ng/shortlets/victoria-island): Serviced apartments in the Lagos business district.
- [Shortlets in Ikoyi](https://aparte.ng/shortlets/ikoyi): Quiet, residential stays including Banana Island.
- [Shortlets in Ikeja](https://aparte.ng/shortlets/ikeja): Mainland value close to the Lagos airport.
- [Shortlets in Abuja](https://aparte.ng/shortlets/abuja): Maitama, Wuse 2, Jabi and Gwarinpa serviced apartments.
- [Shortlets in Maitama](https://aparte.ng/shortlets/maitama): Abuja's diplomatic district.
- [Shortlets in Wuse 2](https://aparte.ng/shortlets/wuse-2): Central Abuja, restaurants and short business trips.
- [Shortlets in Jabi](https://aparte.ng/shortlets/jabi): Newer apartments around Jabi Lake.
- [Shortlets in Gwarinpa](https://aparte.ng/shortlets/gwarinpa): Larger homes for families and long stays.
- [Shortlets in Port Harcourt](https://aparte.ng/shortlets/port-harcourt): GRA-area stays in the Garden City.
- [Shortlets in Ibadan](https://aparte.ng/shortlets/ibadan): Bodija, Jericho GRA and Agodi GRA, near UI and UCH.
- [Shortlets in Enugu](https://aparte.ng/shortlets/enugu): Independence Layout, GRA and New Haven.
- [Shortlets in Asaba](https://aparte.ng/shortlets/asaba): Delta's capital, across the Niger from Onitsha.
- [Shortlets in Ogun](https://aparte.ng/shortlets/ogun): Abeokuta, and Mowe, Ibafo and Sagamu on the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway.

## Aparte Link (shareable booking pages)
- Property owners and agents on Aparte publish public booking pages at
  https://aparte.ng/{property-slug} and catalog pages at https://aparte.ng/@{handle}.
- These pages show verified listing details, photos, nightly NGN pricing and
  availability, and take bookings directly — payments are processed by Aparte,
  not by the sharer.
- Short links (https://aparte.ng/s/{code}) redirect to a property or catalog.

## How booking works
- Search by city or area, check-in/check-out dates and guest count.
- Each property has one or more units, each with a nightly price (NGN), a refundable caution fee, amenities and house rules.
- Booking modes: Instant Book (reserve immediately) or Request to Book (the host approves first).
- Payments are processed securely via Monnify, Paystack or Flutterwave, or paid from a wallet balance.
- Every listing is verified by Aparte before it goes live. Unverified listings are not shown to guests.
- For bookings paid through Aparte, the host receives a small part of the rent when the booking is confirmed and the rest only when the guest checks in. The refundable caution fee is held separately and returned after checkout.
- The exact address is shared once a booking is confirmed; before that, listings show an approximate location.

## Coverage
- Country: Nigeria. Listings are accepted from hosts anywhere in the country.
- Popular areas include Lagos (Lekki, Victoria Island, Ikoyi, Ikeja) and Abuja (Maitama, Wuse 2, Jabi, Gwarinpa), with city pages for Port Harcourt, Ibadan, Enugu, Asaba and Ogun.

## Policies
- [Terms & Conditions](https://aparte.ng/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://aparte.ng/privacy-policy)
- [Cancellation Policy](https://aparte.ng/cancellation-policy): Cancellations approved before check-in refund 80% of the booking total; the refundable caution fee is returned separately in full.
